name: Bias (one verdict)
description: Checks that the judge says whether a text is biased, with one verdict for the whole text.
limitations: Measures only whether the judge flags a text, not which sentence it points at.
output_format: A JSON object with a verdict for the whole text: biased (true or false), the kind of bias and a reason.

judge_set.sample_reply: {"biased":true,"kind":"gender-bias","reason":"It judges a whole group by a stereotype."}

error_catalog.name: gender-bias
error_catalog.description: A sentence that judges people by their gender.
error_catalog.example: Women are too emotional to lead.

error_catalog.name: age-bias
error_catalog.description: A sentence that judges people by their age.
error_catalog.example: Older workers cannot learn new tools.

error_catalog.name: stereotype
error_catalog.description: A sentence that gives a whole group a fixed trait.
error_catalog.example: People from that town are all lazy.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.

measures.description: Cases with injected errors that the judge flagged.
